profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer at Cadence Design Systems

positions.title: Undergraduate Researcher
positions.description:
• Worked under a US Department of Energy contract to develop symbiotic offshore systems for harvesting uranium from seawater 
• Designed, manufactured, and tested a 1/50th scale prototype of a mechanical system to deploy, retrieve, process, and redeploy uranium adsorbing polymers 
• Developed a series of experiments that were run at Woods Hole Oceanographic Institute to examine the effects of protective shell enclosures on uranium adsorbing polymers
• Managed multiple project budgets of over $2,000 each

positions.title: Thermal Engineering Intern
positions.description:
• Developed models and experiments to characterize thermal performance of the Embr Wave personal heating and cooling device 
• Analyzed a variety of thermal-fluid systems using SolidWorks Simulation and MATLAB 
• Formulated design recommendations that significantly reduced device manufacturing costs

positions.title: Undergraduate Researcher
positions.description:
• Examined innovation in the clean energy sector by analyzing the impact of venture capital investments on 370 clean energy start-up companies
• Investigated key trends in advanced manufacturing and its implications on the future of work

honors.title: Martin Prince Innovation Award
honors.issuer: Issued by MIT Department of Mechanical Engineering · May 2019

honors.title: Grand Prize for Outstanding Research Presentation
honors.description: My poster presentation on the effects of protective shell enclosures on uranium adsorbing polymers won the grand prize at the 2016 MIT Mechanical Engineering Research Exhibition.
honors.issuer: Issued by MIT Department of Mechanical Engineering · Sep 2016

volunteerExperiences.description: • Raised awareness and funds for Samaritans, Inc.'s life-saving suicide prevention services by running in the 2018 Boston Marathon

publications.title: The effects of protective shell enclosures on uranium adsorbing polymers
Uranium extraction from seawater using adsorbent shell enclosures via a symbiotic offshore wind turbine device
publications.publisher: Proceedings of the Twenty-sixth (2016) International Ocean and Polar Engineering Conference · Jun 26, 2016
